Joint reaction forces

DL+SDL = 1.0 DL + 1.0 SDL · signed component-wise addition.

■ FX / X · Red■ FY / Y · Green■ FZ / Z · Blue

Equal nominal lengths, not proportional to force. Arrow tails are at the matched Column C point; signs set direction along global X/Y/Z. Exactly zero components have no arrow. Moments are not displayed.

Reaction Story and Output Case are independent of the geometry story filter. Both respect module visibility. Missing case/story combinations show no reactions, never substituted values. DL+SDL is the signed component-wise sum 1.0 DL + 1.0 SDL at the same module, Story and Unique Name. Both source cases must exist; no load factors or absolute values are applied.

Centre of gravity · FZ estimate

One yellow crosshair per enabled module, using the selected Reaction Story and Output Case (including DL+SDL). Independent of arrow visibility and component switches.

X = Σ(FZ × X) / ΣFZ
Y = Σ(FZ × Y) / ΣFZ
Signed FZ values are used; never absolute values.

This is the vertical-reaction resultant location in plan. It estimates the plan CoG only for a suitable gravity-only equilibrium case with complete reactions and negligible support couples. Physical CoG height cannot be obtained from FZ alone. Yellow markers use the midpoint of the selected reaction points’ Z range as a display plane, not CoG height.

View controls

Beams and columns are shown as schematic tubes along their exact end-point axes. Floors and walls are zero-thickness surfaces. Section sizes and thicknesses were not supplied.

Connectivity & source review

Coordinate review — read before assembly

Original coordinates are retained, not assumed to form a verified assembly. Several module exports overlap. No overlaps are merged and no placement corrections are inferred.

M71 is exported close to X = 0 m, unlike the main cluster around X = 305–398 m. M70 and M74 include Normal stories at Z = 0–3.45 m as well as Lifting stories at Z = 23.45–27.10 m. Use the story filter to inspect these separately.

M51 walls with object IDs 33 and 24 have slightly non-planar outlines; they are triangulated from their original vertices. See the exported validation notes for the measured deviations.

Geometry and source notes

Continuation rows are joined by object ID, in the exported Order sequence, before triangulation. Concave outlines are preserved. Coordinate units follow the connectivity worksheets (m); the separate Program Control display-unit setting is not used.

Joint Reactions show the exported FX, FY and FZ values for the selected Story and Output Case. Arrows are nominal-length signed vectors, not scaled force magnitudes. No moments, deformations or design adequacy are inferred.
